title: Increment-result branch check
statement: Let $B$ be a finite Boolean machine, let $q_v,q_i$ be designated states, let $stop$ be a Boolean parameter, and let $x,s,v$ be Boolean words. From administrative state $4$, with tape zero containing $s$, the last tape containing $v$, the other tapes blank, both endpoint heads at $0$, and empty output, one step preserves the entire tape and head configuration and transfers control to the anchor state $0$ if $v$ is empty, and to state $5$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Tape zero and last tape contain the specified word tapes; intermediate tapes are blank
Endpoint heads are at $0$ and output is empty
replaced:
One step of the enumerator body from the increment-check state, at the two-ended
configuration with candidate $s$ and captured increment result $v$, preserves
all tapes and transfers control to the anchor when $v$ is empty (overflow) and
to the result-copy state otherwise.
